branch_note: Created off feature/scan-library (commit 7bcc6c9) as a stacked branch; rebases onto main once scan-library merges.

objectives.goal: Generalize scan-library's single-plugin model into a multi-stage, config-driven plugin pipeline: categorized plugins (parsers/enrichers/post-actions), an orchestrator that selects plugins per library config, external enrichers (TMDB/Kinopoisk) reusing AuthContext/required_secrets, and per-plugin Item provenance + lifecycle state. Realizes the deferred enrich engine. Builds additively on scan-library (deprecate-don't-delete).

key_decisions.phasing: PHASED. This plan = Phase A only. Full feature (3 categories + orchestrator + provenance + external enrichers + post-actions + async queue) cannot fit one pass (would exceed 15-step/8-AC/symbol-budget gates + realize the entire deferred enrich engine). Objective explicitly authorized phasing.
key_decisions.phase_a_scope: parseTV extraction -> tv-parser (metadata_source plugin); internal/enrich inline serial orchestrator (Match->BuildRequest->Convert->Merge, fetch stubbed, namespace enforcement, provenance, state transitions); V5-hybrid lifecycle state (status column + _stages doc map); base-scanner media-type-agnostic; provenance/_view/_stages document schema; API status field/filter. Shippable standalone: fresh install scans TV end-to-end with per-plugin provenance + lifecycle state, no external calls.
key_decisions.phase_b_outline: external enricher (TMDB): real HTTP fetch in BuildRequest->Convert, AuthContext/required_secrets injection, arch §4.4 async derived-queue + per-item leases + enrichment_failures ledger, failed->pending retry, stale/ready states.
key_decisions.phase_c_outline: post-action capability: REQUIRES architecture design first (no contract exists today; closest analogs are deferred janitor + core L2 reconciliation). Flagged design question, not built.

open_question_resolutions.Q1_pipeline_model: Fixed sequential stages (discovery -> identify -> metadata_source chain in module priority order), serial within item (D8), no hybrid (D14). NOT a DAG. DAG = named revisit (Q-new).
open_question_resolutions.Q2_proto_shapes: ADDITIVE: reuse EXISTING capabilities (scanner + metadata_source). NO proto edits for Phase A (metadata.v1 already generated/committed). Creating 3 new category services would FAIL the symbol budget (plugin 9->12) and duplicate metadata_source. tv-parser + external enrichers implement metadata_source; base-scanner keeps scanner (parseTV removed).
open_question_resolutions.Q3_provenance_schema: Implement arch §3.1 verbatim: sources.<plugin_id> (lossless) + _provenance.<field_path> (common.v1.Provenance) + _view.<field> (recomputable; store already projects $._view.title.value via generated columns). PLUS _stages[] progress map (V5-hybrid). Document JSON (opaque to store) -> NO store symbol change. Per arch §0 #4 / D3.
open_question_resolutions.Q4_parseTV_boundary: base-scanner keeps discovery (Scan: walk+ffprobe+withinRoot) + media-type-agnostic base Identify. parseTV + 4 regexes + helpers moves VERBATIM to plugins/tv-parser (a metadata_source plugin). Single call site scanner.go:47 removed. DiscoveredFile/IdentifyResult need NO proto change.
open_question_resolutions.Q5_plugin_bundling: tv-parser = separate subprocess binary (plugins/tv-parser/), dev-mode filesystem load (MELLIFERA_TV_PARSER env, mgr.Load+Start), same as base-scanner. go:embed first-run extraction stays deferred (D11/Q20).
open_question_resolutions.Q6_external_auth: Reuse existing AuthContext/required_secrets (common.proto + plugin.proto CapabilityDeclaration.required_secrets). External enrichers declare required_secrets at handshake; orchestrator injects AuthContext{mode:SERVER,server_secrets} at BuildRequest. Phase B implements; Phase A carries the field (stub passes empty AuthContext).
open_question_resolutions.D8_lifecycle_state: V5 hybrid (recommended): queryable status enum column (new/pending/parsed/enriched/failed/deleted) + per-stage _stages[] progress map in document. Orchestrator advances state via pure nextState fn; store owns the column. Additive (DEFAULT 'new'). Surface at plan-review: state set, V5 choice, backfill of existing scan-library rows.

key_decisions.category_reconciliation_R1: The user's 'parser/enricher/post-action' 3-category taxonomy is NOT in the architecture; authoritative taxonomy = capabilities (scanner, metadata_source). Phase A MAPS: parser/discovery -> scanner (base-scanner) + tv-parser-as-first-metadata_source; enricher -> metadata_source; post-action -> DEFERRED (no contract). Satisfies user INTENT (categorized/staged/config-driven/provenanced/agnostic) with zero new protos. #1 plan-review item.
key_decisions.grounding_method: No .source_map.json in repo. Grounding via 3 parallel Explore agents (shipped Go code, scan-library plan, authoritative design docs) with file:line citations, cross-checked against docs/.project_context.json src_layout and direct reads of check.sh + project_structure.md + SKILL.md.
